title: An app you don’t need, and a company of bad principles
body:
The app seems powerful, useful and full of content. But it’s not. No real substance. 
Better alternatives out there.

The people behind it seems less out to spread the message of habits good life, and more focused on luring people in with trial and then 1 year (!) contract. 

If it was for free, it would have been 2-3 stars (not more) but with the heavy price tag and the aggressive trial setup it’s a scam. (Typical quality failure: the app has a lot of little sounds, which can be completely turned off, or always on - including with the silence switch set on silence mode! That is so stupid.)

I tried it for a few weeks (last year). And than tried to cancel.  I cancelled in the subscription area, which clearly states that I have cancelled the subscription before the renewal. iCloud subscription page in iCloud says its cancelled since June this year. So I contacted them explaining that I don’t use it and by Some fault it was debited again (for another year) although I don’t want it and they said they can’t refund me. The free trial is a setup to trick people to heavily overpay for a very limited service. How can apple accept this?!

title: Fabulous is Fabulous
body:
A little awkward to navigate on the first day (but isn’t that with most things?). I believe it is the intention of the creator(s) to have it so. It strengthens the users intention to continue with the program.  

I have just finished day 3. It’s so easy and does not require a lot of time. Just about as much time as it takes to drink a glass of water. 

Hugely recommend it. 

10 stars if 5. 

The use of the quotes and stories are intuitive. The narrators voice is relaxing. The music is calming ( I have it playing in the background while I’m driving.).

Looking forward to seeing how this program help cure my addiction to procrastination.

title: Lots of helpful fun
body:
I’m impressed that there’s an app of that kind which I haven’t ditched after a week. I’ve had it for two weeks now and I still don’t feel one bit bored. 

It’s fun, doesn’t have too much of the usual “You’re the best, I knew you can do it, you’re a star, what a fantastic performance!!!” They pop up every now and then but reasonably enough to avoid the feeling of butt licking ;) 

What’s most important for me, is that it keeps me disciplined - I mean at the end of the day, who am I cheating, myself? Plus, I feel kind of embarrassed when I’m supposed to leave the ritual undone :) 

So, good job, I’m looking forward to my next journeys and app development!
